stories.title: 'We just really have that pride': Inside Ballhalla, a basketball heaven
stories.summary: Golden State's arena has quickly become known for the best atmosphere in the W. Welcome to Ballhalla.

stories.title: 'No controversy': Cousins to remain Raiders' starting QB, Kubiak says
stories.summary: Kirk Cousins will remain the Raiders' starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the Jets, coach Klint Kubiak announced Monday.

stories.title: Thunder star Williams stretchered off after suffering significant leg injury
stories.summary: There was no immediate diagnosis from the Thunder on Jalen Williams' injury, with coach Mark Daigneault saying the team would be briefed Monday morning.

stories.title: Dream location: Game 6 of WNBA Finals to be matinee at Hawks' arena
stories.summary: Game 6 of the WNBA Finals will be played Thursday at 12:30 p.m. ET at State Farm Arena in Atlanta. The start time of Cavs-Hawks will be pushed back to 8 p.m. ET.

stories.title: Rodgers touts full week of international games, jabs at 'tight' NFL owners
stories.summary: Aaron Rodgers advocated for the NFL to schedule a full week of international games and also jabbed at owners, hinting that they pay lip service to player safety.
